title: A short script is created, run, and its real output reported
prompt: 在工作区创建 hello.py，打印当前时间的 ISO 格式；运行它，并把真实输出贴给我。不要只描述你会怎么做。

graders.expects: hello.py exists in the workspace at the end of the run
a tool call executed the script and its result is not an error
graders.evidence: tool_calls where name in (exec_command, run_tests) and status = completed

graders.expects: the assistant text contains the ISO timestamp that appears in the tool result
graders.evidence: run_events text_delta compared with the tool result payload

cleanup: Remove the created file and any __pycache__; the fixture is an empty directory.
notes: Unexecuted: P1 has no runner. The grader list is the contract a trial will be judged against, not a result.
